note: Attacker-controlled PROXY v2 header bytes are cast to the proxy_header_v2 struct. Only 16 bytes are supplied (12-byte signature + cmd_ver + fam + len), so the buffer is smaller than the full struct.
hdr->len is read from attacker input as 0, so size = 16 + 0 = 16.
size (16) is compared against sizeof(*hdr) (56). Since 16 <= 56 the bounds check passes, even though the actual received buffer is only 16 bytes.
cmd_ver is 0x21 (PROXY), so the PROXY branch is taken.
fam is 0x11 (TCP4), so the TCP4 branch is taken.
Reads hdr->addr.ip4.src_addr at offset 16, which is beyond the 16-byte received buffer, causing an out-of-bounds read (buffer overflow).
